summary: Michigan-born televangelist Jim Bakker built the PTL network and Heritage USA theme park on donor money, was convicted of fraud in 1989 after a rape scandal, then returned selling doomsday food buckets.

evidence.note: extended account of his molestation by an adult church member from age eleven
Bakkers join Pat Robertson's CBN with a puppet show, then the first Christian talk show
satellite broadcasting turns PTL into a Christian TV network with a devoted audience
oversold lifetime partnerships and overpriced statues described as outright fraud
detailed account of the 1980 drugging and rape of church secretary Jessica Hahn
1989 conviction on 24 counts, sentence later cut, paroled after about five years
post-prison pivot to apocalyptic preaching and selling survival food as donations
pro-Trump politics, attacks on Clinton and Obama, attendance at the 2017 inauguration

notes: Lifetime rule sets covered_span 1940-2020 (alive at release). main_span starts 1966 with the CBN puppet show (transcript says early 1960s; 1966 from general knowledge).
